structural_coordinates: Navier-Stokes scaling: u_lambda=lambda u(lambda x,lambda^2 t), omega_lambda=lambda^2 omega(lambda x,lambda^2 t).
Global enstrophy y=||omega||_2^2 has scaling dimension length^-1; (T-t)^(1/2)y is scale invariant.
Finite energy dissipation supplies an L1_t enstrophy budget, not an L-infinity_t enstrophy trace.
Vortex stretching has one derivative and cubic criticality; standard interpolation risks a superlinear y^3 closure.
A Type-I-compatible y~(T-t)^(-1/2) profile is integrable in time but unbounded and has constant rescaled enstrophy.

Pineau-Vicol Proposition 9.5 consumes sufficiently small one-time rescaled local enstrophy under stronger pointwise Type-I and annular-pressure hypotheses; the producer must not assume that smallness.
Local cutoffs introduce transport/pressure/boundary errors, so the global smooth-decaying identity is a deliberately favorable test of the standard route.
Global Lorentz/far-field production, vorticity-direction normalization, and pre-singularity/ancient-state gluing remain separate residuals.
Pending PR#131 may alter routing only; it cannot bear theorem or canonical-memory authority.
